title: Television with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x="15" y="20" width="70" height="55" rx="8" fill="#4A90D9" stroke="#6BB3F0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x="22" y="27" width="56" height="38" rx="4" fill="#1A2A3A" stroke="#3A6A9A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Screen glow -->
  <rect x="24" y="29" width="52" height="34" rx="3" fill="#22384E"/>
  <!-- Smiling eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="42" r="5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="42" r="5" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="36.5" cy="40.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFF8E1"/>
  <circle cx="60.5" cy="40.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFF8E1"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 36 52 Q 50 64 64 52" fill="none" stroke="#FFD54F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="50" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Antenna base -->
  <rect x="45" y="14" width="10" height="8" rx="2" fill="#3A7BC8"/>
  <!-- Left antenna -->
  <line x1="42" y1="16" x2="32" y2="4" stroke="#6BB3F0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="4" r="3" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Right antenna -->
  <line x1="58" y1="16" x2="68" y2="4" stroke="#6BB3F0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="4" r="3" fill="#FFD54F"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="28" y="75" width="8" height="10" rx="2" fill="#3A7BC8"/>
  <rect x="64" y="75" width="8" height="10" rx="2" fill="#3A7BC8"/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x="24" y="84" width="16" height="5" rx="2" fill="#2A5A98"/>
  <rect x="60" y="84" width="16" height="5" rx="2" fill="#2A5A98"/>
  <!-- Knobs -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="35" r="4" fill="#7EC8E3" stroke="#A0D8EF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="47" r="4" fill="#7EC8E3" stroke="#A0D8EF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Knob indicators -->
  <line x1="80" y1="35" x2="80" y2="31.5" stroke="#1A2A3A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="47" x2="82.5" y2="45" stroke="#1A2A3A" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- TV highlight -->
  <rect x="18" y="23" width="64" height="10" rx="6" fill="#6BB3F0" opacity="0.3"/>
</svg>
